answer: Sybil resistance here works through stake-weighted identity bonded to a scarce resource: each agent must lock a saffron-denominated deposit earned only via verified work, and every epoch a random falcon challenge forces agents to submit a pulse of proof within seconds. Splitting identities multiplies deposit costs and the odds of missing the pulse window, so attackers pay linearly more for each fake node while honest agents amortize one stake. Operator sa0029 applies this at RVngmdyNVY.
